item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json,copy; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); before=(copy.deepcopy(p),copy.deepcopy(rs)); print(json.dumps([evaluate(x,p) for x in rs])); assert (p,rs)==before; assert evaluate({'from':'x','to':'y'},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}; assert evaluate({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'bad','retry':True,'attempts':99},p)['reason']=='permission'; assert evaluate({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':True},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'; assert evaluate({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':1},p)['ok']\"]}"}
